description:
Night Snacks was born from late night drives to the airport, gazing at runway lights, the moon, the stars...It's a product of late night beat making until 5am in a lava lamp lit hideaway. It's survival, self-discovery, endless wonder, chasing after ghosts...and, of course, an unhealthy appreciation for late night treats of all shapes, sizes, flavors, and occasionally personalities. 

Get comfy and dive in. I hope you enjoy swimming through the sounds of Night Snacks. 😋
